changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard forms (Pointer-Generator instead of Point-Generator) and simplified outputs description
Simplified ROUGE variants to base form ROUGE as per normalization rules. Removed ROUGE-P as it's not a standard metric name and appears to be a reference to precision variant mentioned in appendix.
Removed placeholder 'None' values since no LLM evaluation was conducted. The paper uses human evaluation, not LLM-as-judge.

guideline: Annotators select incorrect segments in summaries and assign one of 8 issue types (Accuracy: Addition, Omission, Inaccuracy Intrinsic, Inaccuracy Extrinsic, Positive-Negative Aspect; Fluency: Duplication, Word Form, Word Order) and one of 8 syntactic labels (Subject, Predicate, Object, Number&Time, Place&Name, Attribute, Function Word, Whole Sentence). Severity levels (MINOR, MAJOR, CRITICAL) are automatically calculated based on error type and syntactic label.
- Upon a preliminary selection, he is asked to make a further selection among 8 issue types and 8 syntactic labels, respectively.

Annotators select incorrect segments and assign one of 8 issue types (Addition, Omission, Inaccuracy Intrinsic, Inaccuracy Extrinsic, Positive-Negative Aspect, Duplication, Word Order, Word Form) and one of 8 syntactic labels according to the PolyTope framework.

Annotators are asked to select segments that are deemed incorrect after reading. Upon a preliminary selection, he is asked to make a further selection among 8 issue types and 8 syntactic labels, respectively.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated the repetitive guideline descriptions into one comprehensive description. Added 'Accuracy' and 'Fluency' as higher-level criteria that encompass the specific error types.

overall_notes: The paper is a comprehensive evaluation study of text summarization systems using both automatic metrics (ROUGE) and fine-grained human evaluation (PolyTope framework based on MQM). The extraction was generally accurate, with minor normalization needed for model names and metric variants. The human evaluation methodology is well-documented with detailed error categorization.
